full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white comic illustration shows a man crouching beside a fallen figure in a rough outdoor clearing while a brilliant flash erupts near a distant car. A nearly solid black sky fills the upper center and right, framed at the upper left by pale scratched branches. In the left foreground, the crouching man faces right, one knee raised and his torso pitched forward. His light shirt, dark tie, and trousers are rendered with strong ink folds, sharp shadow cuts, and fine parallel hatching. He looks toward the person lying across the lower right on short grass and broken ground. The fallen figure is seen from the side, wearing pale clothing that catches the light; the face and body are partly obscured by dark grass and the edge of the frame. At mid-distance, an older rounded car is parked with its rear toward the viewer. To the right of it, a small standing silhouette is caught against a large white burst that radiates through smoke or dust in curved, stippled streaks. The blast creates the brightest area and bleaches nearby ground, while the figures at left remain separated by crisp white highlights against heavy black masses. Rapid hatch marks describe grass tufts, trouser creases, and the turbulent cloud; long dark areas preserve the nocturnal drama. The monochrome ink surface has a gritty printed grain rather than a smooth digital gradient. The overall composition leads the eye from the crouched foreground figure past the fallen body toward the distant explosion, using extreme black-white contrast and compressed storytelling to create suspense.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白漫画插画描绘一名男子蹲在粗糙户外空地上的倒地者旁，远处一辆车附近突然爆发耀眼白光。近乎纯黑的天空占据上方中央与右侧，左上角有浅色刮线般枝条形成框边。左侧前景中，蹲着的男子面朝右，一膝抬起，上身前倾。浅色衬衫、深色领带与长裤由有力的墨线衣褶、锐利的阴影切面和细密平行排线表现。他看向横躺在右下方短草与碎石地上的人物。倒地者从侧面可见，穿着接住光线的浅色衣物，脸和身体部分被深色草丛与画边遮住。中远处，一辆旧式圆润汽车以车尾朝向观者停放。汽车右边，小小的站立剪影立在一片巨大白色爆光前，烟尘或灰雾以弯曲、点状的笔迹向外放射。强光形成最亮区域，使附近地面泛白，左侧人物则靠重黑块中的清晰白色高光分离出来。快速排线描写草丛、裤褶与翻涌的云团；长片暗部保留夜色中的戏剧性。单色墨面有粗粝印刷颗粒，而非平滑数字渐层。整体构图引导视线从蹲伏的前景人物经过倒地者，再抵达远处爆光，以极端黑白对比和压缩叙事制造悬念。
style_prompt_en: The comic-ink treatment relies on forceful black masses, clean white reserves, and tightly controlled crosshatching. Dense dark fields isolate smaller bright passages, giving each focal shift a clear value hierarchy. Contours cut sharply around the most important forms, while quick broken strokes, stipple, and radiating hatches roughen secondary areas. Brightness arrives in concentrated bursts rather than gentle overall fill, causing nearby surfaces to flare and distant portions to sink into black. Printed grain and slight irregularity keep the high contrast tactile. A diagonal progression through foreground, middle distance, and a distant luminous point compresses action into a single dramatic field. The overall effect is gritty, graphic, and urgent, with line direction and negative space carrying much of the motion.
style_prompt_zh: 这种漫画墨绘依靠有力的黑色大块、干净留白和受控制的密集交叉排线。厚重暗场隔离较小亮区，让每次焦点转移都有清晰的明度主次。最重要形体的轮廓锐利切出，次要区域则由快速断线、点刻与放射状排线变得粗糙。亮度以集中爆发而非温柔均匀铺光出现，使邻近表面骤亮，远处部分沉入黑色。印刷颗粒与轻微不规则感保留高对比画面的触感。前景、中距离与远端亮点之间的斜向递进，把动作压缩到单一戏剧场域。整体效果粗粝、图形化而急迫，线条方向和留白承担大部分动势。
theme_en: A crouching man beside a fallen figure as a distant flash erupts
theme_zh: 远处强光爆发时蹲在倒地者旁的男子
name: Russ Heath
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
